title: Quiet over-ear headphones
description: Active noise cancellation for aircraft cabins and shared offices. Wireless Bluetooth, padded ear cups, 35-hour battery, microphone.

title: Wired studio headphones
description: Closed-back monitoring headphones with a detachable 3.5 mm cable. Neutral sound for recording and mixing; no Bluetooth or active noise cancellation.

title: Waterproof sport earbuds
description: Secure ear hooks and IPX7 water resistance for running and gym workouts. Bluetooth charging case, eight-hour playback, no active noise cancellation.

title: Open-ear clip headphones
description: Lightweight ear clips leave the ear canal open so commuters can hear surrounding traffic. Bluetooth, sweat resistant, six-hour battery.

title: USB gaming headset
description: Over-ear wired USB headset with a flexible boom microphone and physical mute switch for multiplayer games and video calls.

title: Portable waterproof speaker
description: Compact Bluetooth loudspeaker with IP67 protection and carry loop for picnics, showers and poolside listening. Twelve-hour battery.

title: Vertical ergonomic mouse
description: Right-handed wireless vertical mouse keeps the wrist in a handshake position. Adjustable sensitivity and rechargeable USB-C battery.

title: Compact wireless mouse
description: Small ambidextrous travel mouse using a USB receiver. Silent buttons, one AA battery and a slim pouch; conventional horizontal grip.

title: Eight-port USB-C hub
description: Laptop adapter with one HDMI output supporting a single 4K monitor at 60 Hz, Ethernet, USB-A, SD card reader and 100 W charging passthrough.

title: Dual-display laptop dock
description: USB-C docking station for two external HDMI displays, wired Ethernet, four USB ports and 100 W laptop charging. Requires compatible display output on the laptop.

title: Adjustable mesh office chair
description: Breathable office chair with adjustable lumbar support, seat height and arm rests for long work sessions. Five-wheel base.

title: Gas-spring monitor arm
description: Desk clamp mount for one 17 to 32 inch monitor. VESA 75 and 100 mm, adjustable height, tilt and swivel; frees desk space.

title: Waterproof hiking daypack
description: Twenty-litre roll-top dry backpack with welded seams for wet hikes and kayaking. No padded laptop sleeve.

title: Commuter laptop backpack
description: Twenty-two-litre bag with a padded 15 inch laptop compartment, organizer pockets and luggage strap. Water-resistant fabric, not submersible.

title: Cabin rolling suitcase
description: Hard-shell carry-on luggage with four spinner wheels and telescoping handle. Dimensions 55 by 40 by 20 cm; check airline allowances.

title: Universal travel plug adapter
description: Plug adapter for EU, UK, US and Australia sockets with USB charging ports. Does not convert mains voltage.

title: Insulated steel water bottle
description: Leakproof 750 ml vacuum flask keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours. Reusable stainless steel bottle for day trips.

title: 65 W laptop power bank
description: 20000 mAh portable battery with 65 W USB-C Power Delivery for compatible laptops and phones. Charge status display and included USB-C cable.

title: Portable solid-state drive 1 TB
description: Compact external SSD with USB-C, up to 1050 MB per second transfer, and shock-resistant housing. Fast storage for video projects on the move.

title: Desktop backup hard drive 4 TB
description: External USB spinning hard disk with four terabytes of capacity for scheduled desktop backups. Requires the included power adapter.

title: MicroSD memory card 256 GB
description: U3 V30 microSD card for action cameras, drones and 4K recording. Includes a full-size SD adapter.

title: USB flash drive 128 GB
description: Small USB-A memory stick for transferring documents between computers. Key-ring loop, capless design and no cable needed.

title: Two-bay network storage enclosure
description: Diskless NAS with two SATA bays, Ethernet, shared folders and scheduled backups for a home network. Hard drives are sold separately.

title: Portable solid-state drive 2 TB
description: Two-terabyte external SSD with USB-C and up to 1050 MB per second transfer. Compact fast storage for large photo and video libraries.

title: Compact espresso machine
description: Countertop pump espresso maker for ground coffee, with a milk steaming wand for cappuccinos. No built-in grinder.

title: Glass pour-over coffee brewer
description: Manual glass coffee dripper and 600 ml serving carafe. Uses paper filters and separately heated water; no electricity required.

title: Electric burr coffee grinder
description: Conical burr grinder with adjustable grind size for espresso and filter coffee. Electric motor and removable grounds container.

title: Precision coffee scale
description: Digital scale with 0.1 gram resolution, two-kilogram capacity and a timer for repeatable coffee brewing. Rechargeable battery.

title: Temperature-control gooseneck kettle
description: Electric kettle with a narrow spout for precise pour-over coffee. Adjustable water temperature, 900 ml capacity and keep-warm mode.

title: Manual burr coffee grinder
description: Hand-cranked stainless steel burr grinder with adjustable grind size. Portable coffee preparation for camping; no electric power needed.
